annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in India

description: The gross yearly salary in India that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

basic_pct.description: Basic salary. Basic pay as a share of gross; EPF, HRA and NPS limits work on it. (% of gross). Default 50.

employer_nps.description: Employer NPS. Deductible in both regimes: up to 14% of basic (new), 10% (old). (% of basic). Default 0.

epf.description: EPF contribution: none = Not in this calculation; ceiling = 12% on basic up to ₹15,000/month; full = 12% on full basic. Default none.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many INR, for the euro amounts. Default 90 (indicative).

metro.description: Metro city (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai) Default false.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

prof_tax.description: Professional tax (₹2,500/year). Charged by states such as Maharashtra, Karnataka, West Bengal. Default false.

regime.description: Tax regime: new = New regime (default); old = Old regime; best = Whichever is lower. Default new.

sec80c.description: 80C investments besides EPF. PPF, ELSS, life insurance, tuition fees, principal on a home loan. (₹ / year). Default 0.
